name: Love me or not
source:
Hinata finally got the courage to confess to his crush, who is the scariest girl in school.
Choose different paths for him and see how the story goes.

[From [url=https://notaghost01.itch.io/love-me-or-not-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
日向终于鼓起勇气向他暗恋的对象表白，她是学校里最可怕的女孩。
为他选择不同的道路，看看故事会如何发展。

[来自[url=https://notaghost01.itch.io/love-me-or-not-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
